enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Piercing 3: The edges of this weapon have serrated edges, dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage on each hit.
Stabbing 7: The edges of this weapon are serrated, dealing an additional 7d6 piercing damage on each critical hit.

Banishing 45: On Hit: 3d6 Bane damage to Outsiders.On Vorpal Hit: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 1880 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 1880 Hit Points, it takes 3d20 damage.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
